answer: Let each zephyr be one clone; jetty is the only berth ledger pinning key, route and first verdict, so every zephyr collides there. The kth zephyr must bring k sponsors from k disjoint clusters, each locking one vault of k stake to that key; a sponsor backs one live zephyr only, and copied verdicts slash every vault and ban its cluster. n zephyr need n(n+1)/2 disjoint sponsors and about n^3/3 stake held at once. It fails if jetty merges aliases, clusters collude, or vault moves.
